editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Fusion Markets is a legitimate ASIC-regulated broker scoring 7.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. The Zero account at $2.25 per side ($4.50 round-turn) is objectively the cheapest regulated ECN commission available — 36% below the industry average and $1.50 cheaper per lot than the next cheapest competitors (Tickmill, Vantage, FP Markets at $6 RT). Combined with $0 minimum deposit, raw spreads from 0.0 pips, and TradingView integration via cTrader, the cost proposition is unmatched. But the trade-offs are real: only 250 instruments, no FCA or CySEC licence, only 8 years of operating history, and zero educational or research content. Fusion Markets is a pure execution machine built for one type of trader — the experienced scalper who measures their edge in fractions of a pip and needs nothing except the cheapest possible clean fill.
